description: The main application shell for the Local Note Keeper, managing storage, listing, CRUD operations, and selection logic for notes.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main functional component for the Local Note Keeper application.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new note and adds it to the notes state.

methods.description: Deletes the specified note from the notes state.

methods.name: handleEditNote
methods.description: Updates existing note content in the notes state.

methods.description: Explicit save action that returns true.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Sets the selected note ID based on user interaction.
